I'd like to announce the following event scheduled for this Friday:

How can AI companies and human formalization teams work harmoniously together? – a public debate

This will take place in hybrid mode (in person & online), as part of the workshop Formalization and Proof Assistants at UniDistance Switzerland. I am very grateful to @Auguste Poiroux of Math, Inc., for proposing this debate, and agreeing to take part himself.

There's been a lot of discussion about this in this zulip channel (particularly in the last few days), and this is a topic on which feelings are currently running high. I hope that sharing a range of viewpoints on this in a debate format will help to find a way forward.

The talk is scheduled for 2026-03-27T13:30:00+01:00. Zoom link here: https://fernuni.zoom.us/my/davidloeffler
